caption: The drawing shows a central human figure with light skin, dark hair, and a crown, dressed in a long, vertically-striped white robe with black and red accents at the bottom and cuffs, holding a large, stylized sword with a blue blade and a black cross-shaped hilt. The figure’s robe features a black lower section with semi-circular white patterns. Behind and slightly to the right of the central figure, there is a smaller figure with a yellow-orange radiating aura, holding a cross-topped staff in the left hand. The background consists of abstract pastel shapes in beige, orange, lavender, and yellow, framed with a wavy, scalloped orange and black border. The whole scene is set on a plain off-white or cream-colored background.
title: St. John Nepomucene-Painted on Buffalo Hide Prior to 1800
